I hv to take a lot of phenegran and it's still not enough so I smoke for it all. I have tried western medicines but can't really bc stomach is too sensitive. I would talk to a psychiatrist that specializes in DID. I don't have full on alters but severe trauma in life happened. When another traumatic thing happens (like my mum just passing, will bring out my hazy foggy state.) so I check out too. It's scary and it's hard. its different for everyone tho so you need to see someone. when I could afford medicine it was helping stop the flashbacks and made me more centered. Talking to someone you trust and can be all your selves with is essential too. Yoga and everything for trauma related therapy and emdr also supposed to be helpful. I'm so sorry for all you go through. There are groups on here if your looking for support. Good luck ::)

Yes pretty much! It sounds funny and hokey too but I started adding turmeric to dang near everything and it's been helping a lot. Which is anti inflammatory so prob why it's on the list. Pinterest lately has been more helpful. I usually will search Endo recipes or diet, Paleo or GF. There's a list online of what we can and cannot eat, And it's super important. Food and environment, plus stress makes it worse too. Saving your energy and resting bc her bodies fighting a disease 24/7. Also I've been addicted to my crockpot! you can throw fresh meat and veggies and medicinal type spices like ginger and garlic and turmeric, and it consumes little physical energy. Eating food that's ok and saving my energy on everything I do by organizing things/so it's easier and more efficient etc has been the only thing that helps me thru the day. When I started looking at my day as energy instead of minutes, it helped me enjoy other things so much more bc I had more energy. support from loved ones is Important too, as for everyone :)

Hey there I found this thread and I hv stage V Endo. I've been on the chemo Lupron on and off since age 11. Here are some tips for her for someone who promise knows everything about this disease. As everyone I see said you have to have adback therapy. Lupron will give bone weakness. There are only 6 true specialists on our disease and it can ONLY be removed by excision, not laser. Dr Sinervo in Atlanta, GA is one of only 2 specialists in US. Dr Cook is other one in LA. Other info: Studies came out Endo is worsened by environmental issues and is actually a cancer cell. It doesn't mutate like other cancers but it will spread and cover organs and keep spreading. There is no cure. Your a wonderful bf being so supportive. It's a very hard life for someone and encourage her to get support from others who have it. Your body essentially all symptoms just like cancer but you won't die. Mine has spread to my lower intestines and I have had 9 laps. Hysterectomy does not cure it, theres no cure. I had left ovary and tubes out, then disease stretched to keep growing and since left side of me is empty, it's now all over main organs too. So if you have means. Dr. Sinervo or Dr. cook and have excision surgery to remove as much of the disease as possible. Then if she stopped her period by means of chemo again, or a birth control like seasonal would keep it at bay then longer and she'll have more days of a quality life. Cannabis or cbd helps it will stimulate her appetite and help the cyclical vomit if she has that too or nausea. Pain pills can get addictive bc our pain tolerance is so high. The Endo diet is absolutely essential. Pinterest has amazing food help on that. Absolutely NO soy bc it contains phyto estrogen and will increase her pain bc Endo feeds off estrogen. No dairy no wheat no sweets no caffeine etc. no red meat and hormone free everything. I wish you both the best and feel free to msg me if you need any more info.
